[![Discord 链接至 "LopyMine's Project" Discord 服务器](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21f178aff2b64844fefeaf94a3a3a418440fd43f.png)](https://discord.gg/NZzxdkrV4s) [![Github 链接横幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d87060a9e4522786e45b4b54d10853a1b4a91b10.png)](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Particles) [![支持链接横幅 [Boosty]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dce91fef079649dee277c52a998fc068e745e99e.png)](https://boosty.to/lopymine/donate) [![CurseForge 链接横幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c39affcb732c8b1a4fe189e79898c686da3d63e2.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/inventory-particles) [![Modrinth 链接横幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9991553f6a20e5105b9b153b8d817bc3630c18a8.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-particles) !["描述" 标题](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/image2.webp?raw=true) **Inventory Particles** — 一个视觉模组，为你的物品栏物品添加了大量全新粒子！利用它，你可以让物品栏更加生动和动感！当然，完全客户端。 ![游戏内展示](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/ima222ge.webp?raw=true) ![标签 "1300+ 纹理，800+ 区域，400+ 配置"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b31510bc5bff1c5c150a1aadb6a317e220882f6c.png) ![仅装饰](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66456118e8d1bd51d25bd166f33d70e008a0fe6_0.webp) !["可配置" 标题](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/image.webp?raw=true) **Inventory Particles** 中的**所有粒子**都是**数据驱动**的！这意味着你可以仅通过资源包和一些基础配置来添加更多粒子！ **你可以自定义：** 1) 物理效果（加速度、减速度、冲量等） 2) 旋转（实际和视觉） 3) 大小（+动画） 4) 颜色（+动画） 5) 纹理（+动画） 6) 载体（粒子产生的物品） 7) 生成区域（仅需附加纹理） 8) 生命周期（刻数） 9) 以及其他小细节 ^^ > 很遗憾，我们还没有时间制作维基，所以暂时你可以尝试自己摸索 😅
示例配置 ```json { "life_time": 100, "animation_type": "stretch", "animation_speed": 1.0, "size": { "width": 8.0, "height": 8.0 }, // 或 "size": { // https://nicmulvaney.com/easing "interpolation": "ease_in_quint", "sizes": { "0": { "width": 16.0, "height": 16.0, // 覆盖 "ease_in_quint" "interpolation": "linear" }, "50": { "width": 32.0, "height": 32.0 }, "100": { "width": 64.0, "height": 64.0 } } }, "textures": [ "inventory-particles:example/texture_0.png", "inventory-particles:example/texture_1.png" ], "holders": [ { "item": "minecraft:potion", "spawn_area": "example_spawn_area.png", "spawn_count": [0, 1], "spawn_frequency": [5, 20], "speed_coefficient": 0.3, "color": "#AARRGGBB", // 或 "color": { // mixed, random, random_static, gradient, gradient_random_static, gradient_loop, gradient_bounce "mode": "gradient", "values": ["#FF8CC091", "#003700", "nbt", "nbt_list"], "speed": 5.0 }, "nbt_conditions_match": "none", "nbt_conditions": [ { "this_name": "components", "this_type": "object", "next_match": "any", "next": { "this_name": "minecraft:potion_contents", "this_type": "object", "next_match": "any", "next": [ { "this_name": "potion", "this_type": "string", "check_value": "minecraft:water" } ] } } ] } ], "physics": { "base": { "x_speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0], "cursor_impulse_inherit_coefficient": 1.0 }, "y_speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0], "cursor_impulse_inherit_coefficient": 1.0 }, "angle_speed": { "impulse": [1.0, 1.5], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } }, "rotation": { "particle": { "spawn_angle": [0.0, 360.0], "rotate_in_movement_direction": false, "speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": 0.0, "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } }, "texture": { "spawn_angle": [0.0, 0.0], "rotate_in_movement_direction": false, "speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": true, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": 0.0, "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } } } } } ```
![仅装饰](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66456118e8d1bd51d25bd166f33d70e008a0fe6_0.webp) ![展示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c681a00eaa95d93c03b28566a266f2aad3707e5f.png) ### ![图标](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9111988448f778aaff9ac4477e463343fe4dc7e4.png) 想要支持模组和作者？只需告诉所有人这个模组！ 没错，你猜对了。仅通过宣传，你就能很好地支持模组和创作者。越多的人知道这个模组，它就会获得越多的下载量，越多的下载量会给作者带来良好的动力，并增加来自网站的收益（简直是免费捐赠）。**记住，宣传不能是侵入性和烦人的！** ### 你可以做什么？ - 制作视频评测/广告 - 告诉你的朋友这个模组 - 直接下载这个模组（如果你想用它玩的话 :D） # 📑 许可协议 [**查看原始模组仓库。**](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Particles)
